description: This file contains functions for converting messages between Anthropic API format and VS Code Language Model chat message format, including safe object conversion, role mapping, and message content extraction.

methods.name: asObjectSafe
methods.description: Safely converts a value into a plain object, handling null, undefined, JSON strings, and objects.

methods.name: convertToVsCodeLmMessages
methods.description: Converts an array of Anthropic messages into VS Code Language Model chat messages.

methods.name: convertToAnthropicRole
methods.description: Maps VS Code chat message roles to Anthropic role strings.

methods.name: extractTextCountFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text content from a VS Code Language Model chat message.
